title: Webhook configuration
description: Where the runner posts its events besides the file sink: a URL, the secret that signs each delivery, and the event types to send. Lives outside the checkout, beside the policy. Configuring a webhook makes the run fail closed: no run starts unless the receiver answers the ping.

version.description: The configuration format. A runner refuses a version it does not read.

url.description: The receiver's endpoint. https, or http to a loopback address only.

secret.description: The key of the HMAC SHA-256 signature on every delivery. Shared with the receiver and with nothing else; it is the credential of this run's reporting.

events.description: The event types to send, by full type name, or * for every type. Absent means every type. The ping is always sent.
